A '''raid''' on [[Doctor/Legends|Dr.]] [[Nuvo Vindi/Legends|Nuvo Vindi's]] [[Trade Federation laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] was led by [[High Jedi General/Legends|High General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] under the swamps of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

==Prelude==
While searching for [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] activity on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], security forces intercepted and destroyed several CIS scouts and captured a [[Unidentified T-series tactical droid (Nuvo Vindi)|tactical droid]]. After the droid was taken back to [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] to be dismantled, it was discovered that it had been to an area of swamp. Meanwhile, a local [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] herder, [[Peppi Bow/Legends|Peppi Bow]], discovered that the river had been contaminated, and joined [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] on their search for the base.<ref name="Blue Shadow Virus" />

==The raid==
[[File:BlueShadowVirus.png|thumb|left|200px|Amidala, Tano, [[Rex/Legends|Rex]], Binks and troopers amidst the cloud of Blue Shadow Virus.]]

After finding the base, Padmé and Jar Jar were captured, with [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] sent to investigate. They managed to located the compound and created a diversion, allowing Anakin and Obi-Wan to get in while Ahsoka fought off droids. Vindi heard the explosion and had his prisoners tortured, in an attempt to delay Anakin. Clone troopers arrived by gunships, and began to clear out the lab of droids. Padmé and Jar Jar are freed by Anakin who then chased Vindi to his landing platform. After seeing Anakin coming, Vindi activated the detonation sequence to the bombs, each of them carrying strains of the virus in its gaseous form. After reaching the landing platform, Obi-Wan met up with Anakin and the two jumped onto the landing platform. Vindi threw several of the capsules containing the virus, only to have Obi-Wan jump off and catch them. Anakin then confronted Vindi, during which the doctor managed to gain the upper hand. Before he could finish Anakin off, Vindi was knocked out by Peppi Bow. Back in the lab, several clone troopers were able to deactivate the detonation sequence on the bombs, seconds before they were supposed to blow up.<ref name="Blue Shadow Virus" />

<div style="float:right">[[File:Droids_in_Naboo_CIS_lab.png|thumb|200px|Battle droids fire on the remaining clones, while attempting to cut through the exits.]]</div>

After the initial raid, Anakin and Obi-Wan left the compound to take Nuvo Vindi back to [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. However, while they were away, a droid released the virus, causing the facility to lock-down with Ahsoka, Padmé, Jar Jar, and some clones to be trapped inside. Anakin and Obi-Wan meanwhile went to [[Iego/Legends|Iego]] to [[Mission to Iego/Legends|find a cure]] for the virus. The few remaining battle droids then started slicing the exits, hoping to escape the lab and release the virus into Naboo's atmosphere. The remaining Republic forces in the lab began to pick off the droids before they could break out. While being attacked by droidekas, the bio-hazard suit Padmé was wearing became breached and she was infected with the virus. However, she continued on and eventually, the remaining droids had been destroyed. Rex stated that the clones were born to serve the Republic, and Padmé said she that she hoped that their sacrifice would help bring peace to the galaxy, a sentiment confirmed by Ahsoka. Soon after, Ahsoka herself lost consciousness, due to the virus. Before the virus could take its toll on Padmé and Ahsoka, Anakin and Obi-Wan arrived with the cure, freeing the survivors from the contaminated compound.<ref name="Mystery of a Thousand Moons" />

==Behind the scenes==
The raid appeared in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' TV series]] [[The Clone Wars: Season One|Season One]] episodes "[[Blue Shadow Virus (episode)|Blue Shadow Virus]]" and "[[Mystery of a Thousand Moons]]," which premiered together on [[February 13]], [[2009]] as part of a one-hour special.<ref name="A Deadly Virus Unleashed">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/20090209newsb.html|text=A Deadly Virus Unleashed in ''The Clone Wars''}}</ref> The [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|web comic]] [[The Clone Wars: The Valley|''The Valley'']] led into the raid.<ref name="The Valley" />
